QUOTE: "So for tokenize I would not call it retry logic. Nothing is retried after an error: the second call is the real call." and "This is a two-phase 'ask for size, then fill' pattern." and "even there it means resize-and-redo, not retry-after-failure."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer concludes the double call is size negotiation (size probe then fill), not retry-on-failure, with exactly two calls and no error-driven retry.
